journey.name: Payment Deadline History
journey.description: Requests with actual-payment deadlines are visible but cannot be paid by this version of Bitkit. Use a disposable Paykit test identity linked to a controlled shared-runtime peer. Prepare one-time BTC requests with deadlines in proposed, accepted, rejected, canceled and proof-submitted states, plus an incoming, accepted monthly BTC subscription with no end date, a period-start deadline, one paid period and one unpaid period. Acceptance and proof submission must be prepared through the controlled client because Bitkit intentionally cannot accept these terms. Use valid regtest payment proofs. Do not reset or replace a funded wallet to prepare this fixture. On Android, unpaid history rows show status labels, while paid rows show subscription names, notes or dates. Record each payment request id.

actions.action: Open Subscriptions and select the Payments tab after the controlled peer's records have synchronized
Verify the proposed row (id "PaymentRequestRow-<proposed-payment-request-id>") is visible
Verify the accepted row (id "PaymentRequestRow-<accepted-payment-request-id>") is visible
Verify the rejected row (id "PaymentRequestRow-<rejected-payment-request-id>") is visible
Verify the canceled row (id "PaymentRequestRow-<canceled-payment-request-id>") is visible
Verify the completed row (id "PaymentRequestRow-<completed-payment-request-id>") is visible
Open proposed row (id "PaymentRequestRow-<proposed-payment-request-id>") and verify no Pay action appears
Return to Payments
Open accepted row (id "PaymentRequestRow-<accepted-payment-request-id>") and verify no Pay action appears
Return to Payments
Select the Overview tab
Open the active subscription and verify its paid period remains visible and Cancel is available
Return to Subscriptions
Select the Payments tab
Verify the unpaid period is not offered for payment in the Payments tab or pending-request sheet
Have the controlled peer send a new subscription proposal with a period-start deadline
Select the Overview tab after the proposal has synchronized
Open that proposal and verify it explains that its payment details are not supported yet
Verify no Subscribe swipe control appears
Dismiss the proposal to return to Overview
Open the accepted subscription
Cancel the accepted subscription and verify its paid-period history remains accessible
Restart Bitkit and verify the one-time and subscription payment history is still visible
